name: My Bestie is a Femboy Streamer
source:
Your bestie is a Streamer. You've asked him before, but he always remains elusive on the matter under the guise of: "Feeling awkward about his best friend watching him".

Being sorta weird yourself, you do your utmost to respect his decision, but you know what they say: "Curiosity killed the pussy"... 😜

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2772410/]Steam[/url]]
